One dorm, and that is deliberate

There is a single dormitory here. No second building, no crowd, nobody checking in at three in the morning. Everyone who writes about the place lands on the same two words: clean and quiet.

Every category on Hostelworld sits at 10 out of 10 — value, security, atmosphere, cleanliness, staff, location, facilities. Ten reviews is a small sample. It is also a perfect one.

The room

One air-conditioned dormitory, with real luggage space, a wardrobe, lockers and hot showers. There is a shared kitchen with a kettle, a dishwasher and everything you need to cook, plus a dining area, a terrace and a garden to sit in afterwards.

Finding the door

This is the one thing worth reading twice.

Follow the map to Warnagiri, Welhengoda.

There is a large black gate — open it.

Through the gate there is a wooden platform, and the door to Layday is on the right of the house.

Guests have got lost here. Now you will not.

'Warnagiri' Welhengoda, Ahangama, Sri Lanka

“Well located, very clean, good air conditioning and a great host! Layday Surf is just one dorm room with 4 bunk beds so it is very quiet which was amazing. A little bit difficult to find but the host was very responsive and promises a sign will be put up ASAP.”

Newly built, and kept that way

The showers, the beds, the storage: all of it is new and it gets cleaned daily by the people who own it. One guest extended her stay and wrote that she did not want to leave, which is the sentence this place earns most often.
